docs(trajectory-4): seed planning dir with brainstorm + integrated synthesis (#566)

* docs(trajectory-4): seed planning dir with brainstorm + integrated synthesis

Three working artifacts to seat trajectory-4 scope:

* SYNTHESIS-V1-INTERNAL-ONLY.md: substrate-hardening floor distilled
  from the 5-perspective debate (engineer-rigor, security-paranoid,
  compliance-vendor, customer-velocity, devil's-advocate) filtered to
  internal-only code work. Trj3 closeout finalisation, mutation-kill
  uplift, three deferred Kani harnesses, two TLA+ rewrites,
  hosted-vs-portable equivalence property test, multi-region
  partition root-cause, mobile attestation real verifiers.

* BRAINSTORM-V1-FEATURE-CATALOG.md: 9-lens parallel brainstorm
  (DX, perf/scale, capability-extension, protocol-evolution,
  AI-frontier, TEE/HW, trust-graph, observability/SRE, codebase
  archaeology). Includes ground-truth corrections to prior planning
  claims (89 chio-* crates not 119; 819 cargo-vet exemptions not
  179; 6 of 17 threat-model conformance tests still
  unimplemented!() despite gate+codegen+schema; chio-tee is the
  streaming-tap crate not TEE attestation; chio-core is a 12-line
  umbrella not the real core).

* SYNTHESIS-V2-INTEGRATED-PLAN.md: integration of floor + brainstorm
  into a 4-tier scope (T0 floor, T1 multi-agent trust primitives +
  archaeology finish-line + foundational SRE, T2 plumbing +
  hot-path + trust-graph maturity, T3 frontier stretch buffet).
  4-way macaroon-attenuation consensus and 2-way anchor-batch
  Merkle-tree consensus identified as keystones. 25 measurable
  close-bar conditions documented. Recommended scope-lock at
  T0+T1+T2 = 14-18 weeks with parallel lanes.

These are working drafts pending scope-lock; not normative until
trj4 scope is locked and EXECUTION-BOARD.md is authored.

* docs(trajectory-4): comprehensive feature catalog + reviewer-revised plan

Reviewer pass identified 3 P1/P2 issues plus 4 consistency nits.
This commit:

* Expands BRAINSTORM-V1-FEATURE-CATALOG.md to record every
  proposal from all 9 brainstorm lenses (DX, perf/scale, capability,
  protocol, AI-frontier, TEE/HW, trust-graph, observability/SRE,
  codebase archaeology). ~126 distinct items with effort and impact
  ratings, not just the per-lens top-3 picks.

* Adds REJECTED-IDEAS.md cataloging every idea raised and rejected
  during the brainstorm and the 5-perspective scope debate, with
  the rejection rationale for each. Recorded so future trajectories
  can revisit them with fresh information rather than re-deriving.

* Revises SYNTHESIS-V2-INTEGRATED-PLAN.md per reviewer feedback:
  - Threat-count language made exact: 20 threats / 8 covered / 12
    pending, broken down as 6 unimplemented!() stubs + 3 missing
    coveredBy JSON link + 3 mobile-pending. Replaces the prior
    incorrect "6 stubs but listed 11 IDs" wording.
  - Capability-negotiation handshake (chio.capabilities.v1) and
    CapabilityToken schema-tag promoted to T1.0 ahead of macaroon
    caveats (the hinge ordering: caveats and attenuation_proof
    alter the signed capability surface and CapabilityToken has
    no schema field today).
  - Verdict cache key fully specified: composite of cap_hash,
    scope, tool, guard-set hash, policy version, tenant/agent
    identity, caveat state, revocation epoch, trust-root epoch.
    Demoted to T2 stretch only after S-1 flame-graph profile
    lands. Pure-preflight only with explicit invalidation contract.
  - Receipt-DAG formal model expanded: node IDs, parent-set
    hashes, acyclicity invariants, fanout limits, join semantics,
    replay rules. Old "sliding recent_chain_signatures" loop guard
    replaced by formal DAG-level acyclicity from monotone (epoch,
    seq) ordering.
  - Anchor-batch reframed as additive: per-receipt local sign
    stays verifiable; batch root upgrades continuity and
    non-repudiation, does not replace per-receipt signing.
  - BudgetSplit::PerChildShare(f32) replaced with fixed-point
    integer units (basis points or micros). Floats inside
    signed/canonical authority artifacts are a footgun.
  - Narrow chio explain <receipt-id> CLI promoted from T3 to
    T1.6 (CLI only; full web explorer stays in T3 buffet). Makes
    the new receipt DAG, attenuation failures, and close-bar
    evidence legible while the team is building them.
  - Cargo-vet debt added with no-net-new-exemptions close bar
    plus top-50 dependency burn-down (819 -> <=769 target).
  - Three tiers prose corrected to four tiers (T0/T1/T2/T3)
    throughout.
  - 119 workspace members corrected to 89 chio-* crates.
  - Recommended scope-lock narrowed: T0 + T1.0 + T1.1 + T1.2 +
    T1.3 + T1.4 + T1.6 + T2.1 + one of {T1.5, T2.3}, not both.
    Hot-path verdict cache and the unselected sibling become
    explicit stretch.

* Adds README.md to .planning/trajectory-4 explaining doc layout
  and reading order. Marks v1 as superseded but retained as the
  perspective-debate record.

These remain working drafts pending scope-lock; not normative
until trj4 scope is locked and EXECUTION-BOARD.md is authored.

* docs(trajectory-4): round-2 reviewer fixes (gate semantics, cross-kernel DAG, em-dash + whitespace)

Round-2 reviewer pass identified four issues; this commit addresses all.

* Threat-count language re-aligned with the live gate
  (scripts/check-threat-coverage.sh keys on the coverage_state field,
  not coveredBy). Corrected counts: 20 threats / 11 covered / 6 pending
  with deferred_to / 3 uncovered. The 6 pending are the unimplemented!()
  stubs (agent_velocity_abuse, behavioral_sequence_attack,
  cumulative_data_exfiltration, pii_phi_exposure, ssrf_via_http_substrate,
  wasm_guard_resource_exhaustion). The 3 uncovered are the mobile-pending
  rows (mobile_attestation_replay, device_key_extraction,
  play_integrity_token_replay), gate-failing today because they are
  coverage_state: pending without deferred_to. Among the 11 covered,
  pq_signature_downgrade and tee_quote_forgery already carry
  covered_by_tests; only weights_hash_spoof has neither covered_by_tests
  nor coveredBy linkage. The trj4 close-bar item is rewritten so execution
  goes after the right rows.

* Receipt-DAG acyclicity model fixed for cross-kernel safety. The prior
  predicate (child must have later (epoch, seq) than each parent) only
  worked in one kernel clock domain; in a multi-kernel deployment a
  parent from kernel A and child from kernel B inhabit independent
  sequence spaces. Replaced with a signed dag_ordinal per receipt plus
  an HLC (wall_seconds, logical, kernel_id) triple. dag_ordinal is set
  to 1 + max(parent.dag_ordinal); the verifier predicate is
  child.dag_ordinal > max(parent.dag_ordinal), which is total over the
  receipt DAG and rejects cross-kernel cycles without requiring a
  single global clock. Per-kernel (epoch, seq) is retained for in-kernel
  ordering; replay detection on the wire keys on receipt_id (content
  hash). Documented as cheaper than a full vector clock; vector-clock
  variant noted as a future option if federation participants grow
  enough to make per-receipt size matter.

* AGENTS.md house-rule cleanup: scrubbed all 139 em-dash characters
  from the doc set, replaced with hyphens or restructured prose. Final
  count is 0 across all 5 files (BRAINSTORM, SYNTHESIS-V1, SYNTHESIS-V2,
  REJECTED-IDEAS, README).

* Trailing-whitespace cleanup for git diff --check: prior commit's
  proposal heading lines had trailing spaces from markdown soft-break
  syntax (two trailing spaces). Stripped across the doc set.

These are the reviewer's last-mile corrections; substantive scope and
recommended scope-lock are unchanged from the prior commit.

* docs(trajectory-4): round-3 reviewer fixes (gate state, receipt-id migration, T1.1 reframe, hybrid PQ scope, anchor-batch softening, brainstorm tweaks)

Round-3 review identified 7 P1/P2 issues plus 7 brainstorm tweaks.
This commit addresses all.

Reviewer fixes:

* P1 - threat baseline now matches the live gate. On the
  trj4-planning branch (rebased to current origin/main),
  scripts/check-threat-coverage.sh reports PASS at 11 covered /
  9 pending-with-deferred_to / 0 uncovered. The 3 mobile rows
  carry deferred_to: trajectory-4.M07.real-attestation, which
  points at this trajectory by design; they are pending-with-
  deferral, not uncovered. Earlier rounds had the older state
  where deferred_to was missing from the mobile rows. trj4 work
  is now stated as: fill 6 unimplemented stub files, land tests
  for the 3 mobile rows, and add covered_by_tests linkage for
  weights_hash_spoof. End state 20/0/0; gate stays PASS.

* P1 - T1.2 receipt-id migration. Kernel today uses
  next_receipt_id which formats UUIDv7; lineage is v1 single-
  parent (EdgeKind::ReceiptLineageParent). The DAG and replay
  invariants in T1.2 cannot rest on receipt_id already being a
  content hash. T1.2 now adds an explicit migration: signed
  body_hash = H(canonical(receipt_body_minus_signature)) on
  every chio.receipt.v2; receipt_id_v2 = body_hash for v2
  addressing; legacy UUIDv7 receipt_id continues to verify on
  v1 receipts. Negotiation handshake from T1.0 lets peers
  advertise accepts_receipt_v2. T1.2 effort revised from 2 to
  3 weeks to absorb the migration.

* P2 - T1.1 reframed. The substrate already has the authority-
  bearing primitives: CapabilityToken.delegation_chain,
  Attenuation step structure (delegation_receipt.rs:63-110),
  validate_attenuation (capability.rs:2452), and
  validate_delegation_chain, behind a delegation_v2 feature
  gate. The chio-a2a-edge caveats: Vec<String> strings are
  advisory bridge-fidelity prose documenting what the A2A
  protocol cannot project; not authority. T1.1 now promotes
  delegation_v2 to default-on, lifts Attenuation/ScopeAttenuation
  into the chio.capability.v2 schema as first-class fields, and
  makes attenuation_proof an on-the-wire field of the witness
  validate_attenuation already computes. A2A bridge-fidelity
  strings stay advisory.

* P2 - T2.1 hybrid PQ scope expanded. Backend type is
  HybridBackend, not HybridSigningBackend. KernelTrustExchange
  stores a concrete Keypair, not a generic. Capability-token
  schema (spec/schemas/chio-wire/v1/capability/token.schema.json)
  enumerates only ed25519, p256, p384. T2.1 now requires three
  coordinated changes: KernelTrustExchange generic over
  SigningBackend, capability-token schema additions for
  hybrid:ed25519+mldsa65, and wire-format encoder/decoder paths
  treating the hybrid string format as first-class.

* P2 - CLOSEOUT-BLOCKERS continuity declared as deliberate
  scope reset. .planning/trajectory-3/CLOSEOUT-BLOCKERS.md was
  reduced to the M10 entries; the prior 10-blocker catalog
  referenced in TRAJECTORY-FINAL.md is not restored. trj4
  inlines the substantive carry-forward (M10.1, M10.2, M01,
  M02, M07, M08, M09) directly in this plan rather than
  restoring the file.

* P2 - anchor-batch overclaim softened. Previously the plan
  said T1.3 closes the audit_only / transparency_preview
  ceiling. Now it says T1.3 moves toward closure; closure
  requires (per the new T1 Evidence Gate) claim registry
  update, proof manifest update, public-witness semantics
  doc, negative conformance tests for forged batch root,
  mis-ordered inclusion proof, witness-lane impersonation,
  and stale-witness fallback documented. Close-bar item #19
  rewritten.

* P2 - stale 8/20 references in BRAINSTORM catalog updated
  (lines 45, 430, 460, 476).

Brainstorm tweaks added per the round-3 reviewer team:

* T0 reconciliation gate added as mandatory prerequisite for
  any T1 work: CI-DEBT TODOs at zero; trj3 carry-forward
  catalog re-stated in this plan; release anchors live;
  deferred Kani/mutants/TLA tickets enumerated; threat baseline
  confirmed at 11/9/0 PASS.

* T1.5 SRE/log redaction promoted from optional-pick to
  MANDATORY in the recommended scope-lock; T2.3 trust-graph
  quorum/rotation pushed to STRETCH. The PHI-in-PagerDuty risk
  class is too sharp to leave optional.

* Evidence Gate added as mandatory close requirement for every
  T1.x slice: spec/PROTOCOL.md updated, schemas updated, claim
  registry, proof manifest, theorem inventory, generated proof
  report, plus at least one signed negative conformance test.

* Cross-surface conformance added to T2.1: MCP wrapped mode,
  hosted/native edge, A2A or HTTP - deny receipts emit, lineage
  preserved, revocation propagates, budget enforced, no adapter
  bypass.

* Two cheap items added: HTTP SSRF contract enforced on every
  kernel/guard/adapter outbound HTTP path (typed
  HttpEgressContract); policy/manifest semantic-diff gate on
  every PR touching chio-policy or manifest schemas.

* Signed-artifact registry / compat gate added to T1.0: every
  signed artifact's schema ID is cataloged; load-time and
  verify-time both reject unknown schemas.

* Optional split into trj4a (closeout) vs trj4b (multi-agent
  primitives) noted as plan-management option for narrower
  staffing.

Calendar widened from 12-15 weeks (round-2 recommended) to
14-18 weeks (round-3 recommended) to absorb receipt-id
migration, Evidence Gate, and cross-surface conformance.

Em-dash and trailing-whitespace gates stay clean. No code
edited; only doc updates.

* docs(trajectory-4): round-4 reviewer fixes (body_hash self-reference, algorithm enum, catalog stragglers, split consistency)

Round-4 review identified five issues. All addressed.

P1 - body_hash self-reference resolved.
  Previously the spec said body_hash = H(canonical(receipt_body_minus_signature)),
  but body_hash is itself a field on chio.receipt.v2, so a naive
  reading hashes the body_hash field too. Pinned definition:
    BODY_HASH_INPUT = canonical(receipt_body_v2_struct
                                \ {body_hash, signature, receipt_id})
    body_hash       := H(BODY_HASH_INPUT)        # RFC 8785 JCS
    signature_input := BODY_HASH_INPUT || body_hash
  Legacy UUIDv7 receipt_id is retained on the v2 wire shape for
  tooling and replay-store keys but is excluded from the hash
  input because it is per-instance, not content. Pinned by a
  Lean theorem so the input set cannot drift. Three new negative
  conformance cases: mismatched body_hash, self-referential
  implementer error, signature without body_hash commit.

P2 - capability-token algorithm enum corrected.
  signature.v1.json already enumerates ["ed25519","p256","p384","hybrid"];
  the Rust SigningAlgorithm serde shape matches. Round-3 had said
  T2.1 should add `hybrid:ed25519+mldsa65` to the enum, which
  would have made the schema diverge from Rust. Round-4 correction:
  T2.1 adds the `hybrid` enum variant. The alg-set string
  `<classical>+<pq>` lives inside the self-describing wire-value
  pattern `hybrid:<classical>:<pq>:<alg_set>` on issuer / subject /
  signature fields, which T2.1 also updates with the regex pattern
  addition.

P2 - catalog A2A caveats updated.
  The synthesis correctly reframed T1.1 in round-3, but the
  brainstorm catalog convergence thread and the C-3 proposal still
  pointed at chio-a2a-edge `caveats: Vec<String>` strings as the
  substrate to lift. Those are advisory bridge-fidelity prose
  documenting what A2A cannot project, not authority-bearing
  caveats. Both entries now point at the actual primitives:
  CapabilityToken.delegation_chain, Attenuation, ScopeAttenuation,
  validate_attenuation behind the delegation_v2 feature gate.

P2 - catalog HybridSigningBackend -> HybridBackend.
  The exported backend is HybridBackend; HybridSigningBackend does
  not exist. Updated convergence thread (line 43) and T-8 trust-graph
  proposal (line 357). Round-3 changelog entries that record the
  rename remain (with HybridSigningBackend in negative form) because
  they document the correction.

P2 - catalog anchor-batch closure softened.
  Synthesis already says T1.3 moves toward closure of the
  audit_only / transparency_preview ceiling (per the Evidence Gate)
  but the catalog summary still said it closes the ceiling and
  upgrades non-repudiation on its own. Catalog now mirrors the
  softened framing and references the Evidence Gate work.

P3 - split-plan cargo-vet placement clarified.
  trj4a description previously included cargo-vet burn-down even
  though the actual cargo-vet close bar lives under T1.4 (which
  is in trj4b under the split). Round-4: trj4a = Tier 0 only;
  cargo-vet stays in T1.4 / trj4b unless explicitly lifted into
  Tier 0 at scope-lock time.

Em-dash and trailing-whitespace gates remain clean. No code
edited; only doc updates.

* docs(trajectory-4): round-5 reviewer fixes (replay-key authority, typed signing input, attenuation witness API)

Round-5 review identified three issues. All addressed.

P1 - Replay-store keys are body_hash only.
  Previous wording said the legacy UUIDv7 receipt_id was retained
  on v2 wire for both tooling AND replay-store keys, while also
  being non-cryptographic and tamper-tolerated. Those cannot both
  be true: if a tampered UUID still verifies, replay/dedup state
  must not key on it. Fix:
    - Replay/dedup state keys exclusively on body_hash
      (cryptographic identity).
    - Legacy UUIDv7 receipt_id stays on the v2 wire as a
      non-authoritative tooling alias (chio-cli prefix lookup,
      explorer surfaces) but is not read by the replay store,
      DAG verifier, or lineage layer.
    - A tampered legacy receipt_id cannot affect replay
      acceptance because replay never reads it.
    - Negative conformance test (c) updated: tampered legacy
      receipt_id must verify (alias is non-authoritative) AND
      must not cause replay confusion.

P2 - Canonical signing input typed.
  Previous "BODY_HASH_INPUT || body_hash" byte-concat departed from
  the existing sign_canonical pattern and was under-specified
  (implementations could disagree on exact bytes while believing
  they followed the plan). Fix:
    - Define typed `ReceiptV2BodyHashInput` struct in
      chio-core-types containing every v2 body field except
      body_hash, signature, and legacy receipt_id.
    - body_hash := H(canonical_jcs(ReceiptV2BodyHashInput))
      (RFC 8785 over the typed struct).
    - Define typed `ReceiptV2SigningBody { body_hash, body }`
      wrapper. Signature is keypair.sign_canonical(&ReceiptV2SigningBody)
      per the existing CapabilityTokenBody::sign pattern at
      chio-core-types/src/capability.rs:246-248.
    - chio-spec-codegen generates the typed struct from the JSON
      schema so the field set cannot drift.
    - Negative conformance test (d) updated: signature that is
      not sign_canonical(&ReceiptV2SigningBody) must fail closed.

P2 - attenuation_proof requires NEW witness-generation API.
  Earlier wording said T1.1 makes the witness validate_attenuation
  "already computes" an on-the-wire field. That overstated the
  substrate. validate_attenuation(parent, child) at
  crates/chio-core-types/src/capability.rs:2452 only does
  child.is_subset_of(parent) and returns Ok(()) or Err; it does
  not produce a witness. Fix:
    - T1.1 ships a new compute_attenuation_witness /
      verify_attenuation_witness API pair in chio-core-types.
    - compute_attenuation_witness records the normalized canonical
      encoding of each scope, the per-grant subset relation, and
      any restricted predicates.
    - verify_attenuation_witness on the verifier side is faster
      than re-deriving subset normalization.
    - T1.1 promotion of delegation_v2 primitives is now stated
      as "promote AND add the witness API"; both are required.
    - Close-bar item #15 updated.

Em-dash and trailing-whitespace gates remain clean. No code
edited; only doc updates.

* docs(trajectory-4): round-6 reviewer fixes (catalog C-3 attenuation wording, round-4 entry superseded)

Round-6 review identified two narrow, pre-merge issues. Both
addressed.

P2 - BRAINSTORM catalog C-3 still claimed the on-the-wire
attenuation_proof "is the witness validate_attenuation already
computes." Round-5 fixed this in the active synthesis but the
catalog C-3 entry was missed. Catalog now mirrors the synthesis
wording: validate_attenuation only checks child.is_subset_of(parent)
and returns Ok(()) or Err; T1.1 must add new compute_attenuation_witness
and verify_attenuation_witness APIs alongside the existing checker,
and the attenuation_proof field carries that witness on the wire.

P3 - The round-4 changelog entry in SYNTHESIS-V2 still presented
the now-superseded BODY_HASH_INPUT || body_hash byte-concat signing
input and the legacy-UUIDv7-as-replay-key wording as a fix. A future
reader copy-pasting from the pass log could implement the stale
design. Marked the entry "[Superseded by round-5]" with an
explicit pointer to the round-5 entry above and the T1.2 spec
body. Original three negative conformance cases noted as still
valid (extended in round-5).

* docs(trajectory-4): pre-flight infrastructure batch (TRJ4-000) - registries, evidence dir, preflight script, path/policy fixes

Pre-execution batch addressing items (a), (b), (c), (e), (f) from
the "what's left before TRJ4-001" list.

(a) Spec registries bootstrapped at spec/registries/.
  Three new stub files plus a README explain how each registry
  feeds the trj4 Evidence Gate:
  - spec/registries/claim-registry.v1.json: every verifiable
    claim a Chio kernel can make, with schema artifact + status.
    Bootstrapped with the trj1-3 claims that are already enforced
    (signed_authority, signed_decision, attenuation.subset);
    proposed-section lists the six trj4 T1.x claims gated on
    this registry (capability.attenuation_proof,
    receipt.body_hash_addressing, receipt.dag_acyclicity,
    anchor.batch_continuity, handshake.capability_negotiation,
    signature.hybrid_pq).
  - spec/registries/proof-manifest.v1.json: claim -> evidence
    mapping (Lean theorems, Apalache modules, Kani harnesses,
    conformance tests, signed assertions). Bootstrapped with
    trj1-3 manifests; trj4_proposed_manifests section lists the
    evidence shape each T1.x slice has to deliver.
  - spec/registries/theorem-inventory.v1.json: catalog of
    formal theorems with statements, dependencies, status.
    Bootstrapped with the trj1-3 theorems
    (capability.signature_correctness,
    receipt.signature_correctness,
    attenuation.subset_correctness,
    revocation.cut_completeness "proven_partial",
    revocation.eventually_seen "advisory_only" with trj4
    followup pointer); proposed-section lists nine new theorems
